livebench.label: LiveBench
livebench.subtitle: Task performance
livebench.qualification: LiveBench 2.0, NOT the retired LiveBench overall benchmark. Overall is the source's weighted mean (Agentic ×2; Design and Coding ×1.5; other suites ×1). Suites are single runs; effort is highest supported unless the source's expanded row says otherwise. No per-model confidence intervals are supplied. Missing suite results stay missing, not zero. Cost is per successful task.
